title: Rhythm: Quarters and Halves
description: A pure rhythm drill on one note per hand: quarter notes get one count, half notes get two, and you learn to keep a steady pulse while the pattern changes.

arrangements.label: Beginner
arrangements.notes: Single pitches only (E4 in the right hand, C3 in the left) so all attention goes to counting quarters and halves in 4/4.
teachingPoints: Count '1 2 3 4' aloud in every bar; a quarter note is one count, a half note is held for two.
Bars 3 and 4 put the half note at the end and then at the start of the bar - the hardest part is NOT playing on counts 4 and 2.
Bars 5-6 move the same patterns to the left hand on C with finger 5.
Bars 7-8: both hands play the identical rhythm together - they must sound as one note.
